pattern_explanation: Some Polish words look like English words because both languages took them from the same classical roots. Over time the meanings drifted apart, so learners who trust the similar look of the word can pick the wrong English equivalent.
false_friend_warning: Learners may think the Polish word transliterated as sympatyczny matches the English word 'sympathetic', but it actually means friendly or pleasant. 'Sympathetic' in English means showing understanding of someone's feelings, so check the meaning rather than the spelling.
